name: walk-back
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT BACK view facing directly AWAY from viewer, only back of head and back of tunic visible, NO eyes/face/chest laces. Exactly TWO COMPLETE full-body WALK poses in TWO EQUAL cells left then right on one horizontal landscape 1536x1024 sheet. Frame 1 anatomical LEFT leg strides away and RIGHT shoe trails toward camera; frame 2 RIGHT leg strides away and LEFT shoe trails toward camera. Visibly alternate both legs and the gentle opposing arm swing. Slack shambling zombie gait, hunched shoulders; same torso scale and local invisible ground baseline. Each human around 760px high, complete shoes/fingers and generous transparent margins.
